title: MissingMoebTool signals not emitted for ToolSearch and Read in spec session
description: ToolSearch was used to load deferred moeb tool schemas at session start, and Read was used to read the oversized start_spec output file from the tool-results directory. Neither was followed by a MissingMoebTool signal, causing moeb-tool-origin to fail. This is a recurring pattern across spec and run sessions.
proposed_resolution: Add explicit MissingMoebTool signal buffering instructions to spec.skill.md Phase 1 for ToolSearch schema loading and for Read operations on files outside the working directory. Alternatively, introduce a moeb tool that subsumes ToolSearch.
